Hi Mina / CS team —

Quick handoff for a new mid-market deal: Sapphire Health (payer-network analytics). We closed last week; final SOW signed and PO in HubSpot. High-level context and asks below so we can align owners and a kickoff week.\n
Deal highlights:
- ARR: ~$180k first year
- Initial scope: analytics queries + embeddings for member-search, two production endpoints (chat + batch embeddings)
- Security: must support SCIM and SAML SSO, SOC2 evidence requested (we provided certs already)
- Timeline: target pilot start 10/18; go-live for pilot features by 11/15

Customer contacts (attached):
- Sofia Ramirez (Director of Product) — primary technical contact
- Chris Liao (Head of Data Engineering) — infra & SSO

Key open items for CS/Implementation:
1) Confirm implementation lead and technical owner for onboarding weeks (10/11 week preferred for internal prep)
2) Validate SSO metadata and test IdP in staging (SAML) — customer says they can start tests 10/6
3) Decide on scoped tenant isolation (dedicated namespace, no dedicated GPUs) — Finance prefers hosted + customer-provided data retention rules
4) Runbook for traffic ramp: start with 1k/day to pilot, scale to 20k/day post-pilot

Attachments: Sapphire_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal + SOW), SSO_Requirements.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

Next steps I recommend: Mina to assign Implementation Lead and Technical Lead, schedule 30m intro with customer next week.
